bosnia2604-delegate-sections.adaptive/final:
Ms. Farrey supports EUFOR renewal and Christian Schmidt's use of executive powers if needed, while opposing premature office closure. She urges Bosnia to finish the 5+2 agenda before closing the office.

Mr. Nebenzia argues the High Representative post is vacant, citing circumvented Council consensus and the need for Bosnian dialogue free from outside interference.
